verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring automation is a fair question for an email service. The evidence shows only one-off timed actions: Scheduled Send is a title-only doc entry, and Snooze returns a single message to the inbox at a set time. Filters & Rules fire on incoming mail rather than on a schedule, and nothing documents recurring jobs or workflows, so a one-off action cannot stand in for a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
